query: SELECT data, (cat1 + cat2 + cat3 + cat4 + cat5 + cat6 + cat7 + cat8) as sem_cat9, cat9, (cat1 + cat2 + cat3 + cat4 + cat5 + cat6 + cat7 + cat8 + cat9) as total FROM faturamentos WHERE empresaSlug = 'barbiero-mascote' AND YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(data, '%Y-%m-%d')) = 2026 AND MONTH(STR_TO_DATE(data, '%Y-%m-%d')) = 5 ORDER BY data DESC LIMIT 5;
